title: Pending MED+250 Cloudflare least-privilege account verification
summary: Owner-ready workbook for fresh verification of the intended account, canonical production Worker route, protected environments and a non-billable least-privilege deployment credential.

checks.name: Authenticated account visibility
checks.detail: Rerun a redacted management-plane account check and confirm the intended MED+250 account without retaining account identifiers or operator identity.

checks.name: Production deployment visibility
checks.detail: Confirm the production Worker, immutable release version, traffic allocation, preview isolation and rollback target in the intended account.

checks.name: Custom-domain configuration
checks.detail: Confirm med-250.com is attached only to the intended production Worker, workers.dev and preview URLs are disabled for production, and no Sites project or second Worker competes for the hostname.

checks.name: Least-privilege credential
checks.detail: No current redacted proof shows that the release credential is limited to the MED+250 Worker, required route and assets, and read-only zone inspection. Do not place a broad interactive credential in the release path.

checks.name: Infrastructure-owner approval
checks.detail: The named infrastructure owner must verify the replacement credential, confirm old access is revoked, and sign the completed account record.

completion_instructions: Use only a GitHub-free release path and a Cloudflare credential scoped to the MED+250 Worker, med-250.com route, required assets and read-only zone inspection.
Rerun the management-plane checks without retaining account identifiers, operator identity, tokens or permission payloads.
Bind the verified production Worker and rollback target to the exact immutable release revision.
Set every check to passed only from fresh evidence, record the named verifier, role and timezone-qualified timestamp, confirm redactions, and set status to complete.
Validate the completed artifact strictly before recording its exact SHA-256 digest in the launch registry.
